license_notice: CC BY 4.0 (journal-wide, 'about' page of Rev. Inst. Med. trop. São Paulo; no item licence)
availability_check: Not in any official series. Chagas in SINAN is acute Chagas notifications from 2001 (TabNet), never serology.
